tilts.set: SET on 2026-11-06 by the Portfolio Fitness for Fighting judg

industry.why: Neutral at industry level, carried, with the case for Overweight stronger than at any time since the row was set and still not taken. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-11-06 against 2026-09-04, not week on week: A now, C prior: healthcare is the defensive the market is paying for, with Medtech capital goods A, Pharma/biotech B, Medtech consumables B and Pharma manufacturing services B. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only) pays large, proven, cash-yielding cases, which is the Pharma/biotech row (B) and Hospitals (B). Held at C because the industry letter adds the same 30% weight to clinical-stage biotech (D, relative strength F) and capex-cyclical medical equipment as to large pharma, no source spoke to pharmaceuticals against medical technology this week, and eleven of the top 40 on the starting score are already healthcare names. Counter-case for B: two readings two months apart at A with the regime's rotation confirmed on every window; for D: a crowded destination. To B if a source carries a healthcare read with the industry's relative strength holding A or B.

sector.why: Overweight, carried unchanged. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): Wood (via Jefferies, 17 Oct) names healthcare as the diversification from artificial intelligence, Healthcare's industry relative strength rose to B, and large pharma is the large, proven, cash-yielding case the regime pays for; pharmaceuticals against medical technology was not spoken to, so the row rests on the regime and the rotation, not on a pharma call. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: C now, D prior. One Pool name (Genmab, Sell-side A, TSR/Valuation A on the valuation reading only). Counter-case: a defensive destination five weeks into a rotation is crowded, and the franc and dollar move the Swiss and UK names' reported earnings.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. No source spoke to Denmark this week (a source pack is present, 2026-W43, and it carried nothing country-specific here), relative strength is not graded by country, and Richard's view is G10 and Europe-wide with no country line. An absence is an absence; no tilt.

defs.top_half: a close above the midpoint of the day's high-low range; an up day closes at or above the previous close; days with no range are left out
